verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer agent accepts natural-language instructions that act on the product. Users can tell it to save a procedure as a reusable skill, delegate work to sub-agents, and act on workspace files under approval modes. Agentic mode lets models use tools autonomously. However, there is no evidence that core product configuration (admin settings, models, memory, automations) can be driven conversationally; memory, for example, is managed through the Settings UI. missing for 10: natural-language control of product settings and administration, evidence that schedules and automations can be created conversationally, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Save this whole procedure as a skill called release-checklist. Include the tag format and the announcement template.

By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.
